committed_before: any stage B or C training run

external_validation.use: per-epoch checkpoint selection and bounded family selection only
external_validation.materialization: same deterministic box checks as train

external_test.use: exactly once, after one candidate is frozen and committed

data.materialization: rotated line rectangle from the 14 ordered digit boxes; context 0.16/0.04 of line length; 650:180 perspective warp with padding 245; frozen phase2l_a.letterbox to 160x576
materialization_checks: no box clipped or within 1 px of the image border
source line >= 8 px per digit and median digit height >= 10 px
annotation labels equal the protected split target
data.target_order: left-to-right, verified against frozen v2 (forward digit agreement 0.922746 vs reversed 0.14446 on external train)
data.internal_replay_pool: phase2l_a inner_train usable_for_real_training cards (664), the v2 original real training pool
data.eligible_115: phase2m_a annotated eligible inner-train cards; zero identity or exact-image overlap with any external split; zero identity-component or target overlap with the 168 controls; 3 perceptual near-matches with external train (both training sources)
data.original_domain_controls: phase2l_a inner_holdout 168 cards; evaluated once per run at its selected checkpoint, never per epoch

ablation.B: v2 fine-tuned on external train mixed with internal replay
ablation.C: same-seed B selected checkpoint fine-tuned on the 115 eligible cards mixed with external train and internal replay

non_evaluated_smoke_runs: one 20-step timing run on external train, weights discarded

augmentation.partial_card_simulation: not used: the fixed [B,14,10] contract has no reject output, and clipped inputs are never paired with an invisible full target

checkpoint_selection: after every epoch, exact-sequence count on the materialized external validation; keep the maximum; ties keep the earlier epoch; the initial checkpoint is not a candidate

regression_cap_controls.reference: frozen v2 on the same 168 controls

family_eligibility: both seeds: validation exact gain over A > 0, controls within the regression cap, zero short/empty/overlong outputs; and seed-stable
family_selection: highest mean validation exact among eligible families; tie prefers B
seed_selection: higher validation exact; tie prefers the lower seed
reporting: newly exact and regressed exact, not accuracy alone
Egyptian-ID structure validity as diagnostics only, never to rewrite or select
challenge_B as a recognition-domain diagnostic only, never to select
challenge_A remains a capture/admission failure requiring a clearer complete image

decisions.FIXED14_V2_PRESERVATION_FAILURE: v2 hashes, reconstruction, or validated result change
decisions.FIXED14_V3_NOT_IMPROVED: no family is eligible on validation; the external test stays unopened
decisions.FIXED14_V3_TEST_NOT_CONFIRMED: the frozen candidate fails test_success on the one-time external test
decisions.FIXED14_V3_IMPROVEMENT_CONFIRMED: the frozen candidate passes test_success; research candidate only, no production change
